_readme: Every knob that can change what the bot does, what it is set to, and how much evidence is behind it. status: FITTED = measured on held-out data; MEASURED = a property of the venue, not a choice; ASSUMED = a guess nobody has tested; DEAD = present in code but unreachable.

entryDelayMs.unit: ms after the launch block timestamp
entryDelayMs.why: The snipe tax is 4 discrete plateaus keyed on WHOLE elapsed seconds: 9700 / 618 / 19 / 0 bps. Second 2 costs 19bps. Second 1 costs 618bps, 32x more.
entryDelayMs.sensitivity: CLIFF, not a curve. Landing 1s early costs ~6% of the position. Do not tune this like a continuous parameter.
entryDelayMs.liveEvidence: 21 of 21 fills landed on the 19bps band despite filling anywhere from block 13 to 25

entryFallbackLateMs.why: only used if the sequencer feed is down; deliberately aims late because overshooting costs 19bps and undershooting costs 618bps
entryFallbackLateMs.tested: never, no feed outage has happened live

selection._note: This is where the money is. The exit reshapes returns; the filter decides whether there is anything to reshape. Every signal here is attacker-controlled and must be re-tested weekly.

minDevBuyWei.sensitivity: broad plateau. Mean flat 0.08-0.30; median and win rate keep climbing as it rises, trade count falls. Raising it buys consistency with volume.
minDevBuyWei.warning: attacker-controlled. A launcher can fake their own dev buy for the cost of the buy itself, which they get back. It survives measurement, it is not honest.

maxPriorLaunches.unit: reject a deployer who has launched before
maxPriorLaunches.evidence: dev>=0.05 on a REPEAT deployer scores -8.15% held out, vs +7.07% on a first-timer. Serial launchers are negative in every era measured.
maxPriorLaunches.sensitivity: large, and the sign flips. This is the single strongest filter we have.

maxCreatorTaxBps.why: creator tax is charged on both legs; above 100bps the round trip cannot clear the fees

selectionAvailableButUnused._note: Decoded from launch calldata at +0s so all are legal filters. None are currently in the book. The bundle/twitter signals were IN the book until 2026-08-17 and were farmed out: bands scoring +19%/+47% on Aug 13-16 scored -2.8%/-10% days later.

exemptions.meaning: count of snipe-tax-exempt wallets the creator pre-registered, a 'bundle'
exemptions.why: free for the launcher to fake, and they scaled it

launchDensity.meaning: how many coins launched in the prior 10 minutes
launchDensity.hypothesis: a crowded minute means more rival snipers per coin

takeProfitMultiple.unit: multiple of the entry mark (bot units)
takeProfitMultiple.why: Two independent methods agree. (1) Walk-forward: +20% is the last level with a positive median AND >52% win rate in all 5 consecutive time folds. (2) Path anatomy: continuation collapses from 83% to 61% at exactly +20%, while the give-it-all-back rate is FLAT at 21-26% at every level, so height never buys safety.
takeProfitMultiple.sensitivity: The MEAN-optimal value is unstable: 5 folds picked 1.20, 2.00, 1.35, 1.30, 1.75. The CONSISTENCY ranking is monotone and stable in all 5 folds. Rank on consistency; the mean is noise here.
takeProfitMultiple.doNotAdaptivelyRefit: Refitting this on a 2h/4h/6h/12h/24h lookback and trading the next 2h beats a fixed 1.20 on mean (+6.5 to 7.4 vs +5.7) but LOSES on median (+1.2 to +2.9 vs +4.3). The refit keeps chasing 1.5-2.0 off jackpots in the fit window. Leave it fixed.

maxHoldMs.sensitivity: broad plateau 20-45s; falls off hard past 60s. 90s and 120s are catastrophic (median -9% to -11%).
maxHoldMs.why: the coin lifecycle compressed when the farms took over. Median share of own peak ETH at t=120s went from 74% (organic era) to 7% (now).
maxHoldMs.warning: if farms dump earlier the plateau slides LEFT. Re-measure weekly.

hardStopMultiple.why: tail insurance, deliberately loose. Fired 22 times in 1548 trades for a 0.06pp cost.
hardStopMultiple.sensitivity: near zero. Stop-loss sweeps 0.80-0.97 all COST mean and barely help the median: losses here are slow bleed, not crashes.

graduationExitAt.why: at zero the curve refuses sells and the position cannot be exited at any price

trailPct.why: armed at +20% and fired 50% off the peak. Fired ONCE in 656 simulated trades, and a +21% take profit leaves no reachable band between arm and sell. A safety net that cannot fire is worse than none because it reads like one.

stopLoss.result: all cost mean, none improved the median meaningfully

partialScaleOut.result: best was 70%@1.20+30%@1.60, worst-fold mean +4.10 vs +3.57 for the simple rule. Rejected: does not pay for a second sell tx, a second failure mode, and a partial-fill state the recovery path would have to learn.

tightTrails.result: all worse than a plain take profit on median and win rate

tradeSizeEth.note: pilot size, deliberately small. P&L peaks near 0.02 and goes negative by 0.05 because our own buy moves the curve.

maxTradeSizeEth.why: hard ceiling: own-impact on a 1.68 ETH virtual reserve

bankrollEth.note: set to the actual wallet balance on 2026-08-18. Was 0.0796, a stale constant.

maxConcurrent.note: not binding in practice: at 9.5 launches/h and a 45s hold, concurrency rarely exceeds 3

measuredTwoWays: chain: peak flat wallet balance vs current flat balance, survives restarts
session: realized P&L rebuilt from receipts at boot

ethUsd.note: ONE price for the whole tree: bot, monitors, and research all read this env var. Three different values used to coexist.

maxLogsStalenessMs.why: no entries while the authoritative log stream is stale

executionMeasured._note: not choices, measured properties. Listed because they set the floor every strategy has to clear.

roundTripCostPct.components: 100bps curve fee each leg + creator tax + our own price impact + gas
roundTripCostPct.implication: the median coin must move more than this or no exit rule can save it

fillLatency.impact: NONE material: take-profit mean moves +5.33 to +6.04 as lag goes 0.2s to 3.0s

simFrictions._note: sim-only knobs. Calibrated so the sim reproduces live: on the 36 coins actually traded the sim said -6.03% and live delivered -3.05%.

comp.meaning: number of rival bots entering my block at my size

haircut.meaning: fraction shaved off post-entry buy flow
haircut.calibration: 0; a 0.10 haircut was the single largest source of sim error at $4.39 of a $7.24 gap
